PublicBundleDescription: Select a public catalog to import into your new account. This will start you off with a ready-to-use speaking account.
PublicBundleLevelADescription: This basic vocabulary is intentionally limited and designed to be expanded by a healthcare professional, ideally a speech therapist. However, it allows users to become familiar with Pictalk fundamentals. Recommended for beginners in AAC, it avoids cognitive overload by limiting the number of pictograms initially.
PublicBundleLevelBDescription: This much richer vocabulary provides a solid foundation for users already familiar with pictograms and having some prior vocabulary knowledge. It is ideal for those looking for more fluid and varied communication.

TutorialsCreationText: In this tutorial, you will learn how to create, edit, and delete pictograms and collections. By the end of the video, you will know how to create a new collection and add pictograms to it. You will also see how to edit an image in Pictalk.
TutorialsCreation: Creating, editing, and deleting pictograms and collections
TutorialsOrganizingText: In this tutorial, you will learn how to organize pictograms and collections. By the end of the video, you will easily master Pictalk’s most powerful organization tools, like drag and drop.

TutorialsSharingText: In this tutorial, you will learn how to share pictograms and collections. By the end of the video, you will know how to share a collection with other users and how to integrate shared collections into your personal space.

TitleCompleteKeywords: Speak with pictograms for autism and more
DescriptionSEO: Pictalk helps people with physical or mental disabilities communicate using pictograms and images. These can include: Autism, Down syndrome, apraxia, stroke, and more.
PopupCreateAccountText6: No limit on space or pictograms 💾
PopupCreateAccountText21: Modify your voice, tone, and speed 🗣️
AnalyticsText: Help us understand how you use Pictalk. Information remains anonymous and is not shared with anyone 🕵️‍♀️

ErrorSubtitle: Sometimes things don't go as planned and errors happen, especially after updates. Please note that bugs are automatically reported to us. If the issue continues, email us or join us on Facebook or Instagram. Click the button below to try fixing the error.
DonationText1:
Thank you for using Pictalk! 🙏

10,000 of you communicate thanks to this free app.

$5/month = One family that keeps access to servers and new features.

No ads, no shareholders. Just families supporting each other.
DonationText2:
Pictalk is free because 200 families give for 10,000.
Join this supportive community.
Your contribution funds the servers, development, and keeps the app 100% accessible.
$5/month or $50/year = Real impact.
DonationText3:
How does Pictalk stay free?

✅ No ads
✅ No shareholders
✅ A community of families who give according to their means

Can you help? $5/month is enough to maintain the service for hundreds of families.
DonationText4:
Communication is a right, not a privilege.
We created Pictalk for Pablo, our non-verbal little brother. Today, 10,000 people use it for free.
Help us keep this promise. Even $5/month makes a difference
